name: Amanohashi Ikkaku
source:
The chairman of Habataki Academy's board of directors. At first, he appears as a mysterious dandy whose true identity is unknown, but his identity is revealed later on. He is said to be close friends with fashion designer Goro Hanatsubaki since their school days. A kind gentleman who cares about the protagonist in many ways. It seems his dream is to cultivate an elegant lady with his own hands. His hobbies are cruising and swimming. His favorite music is classical music.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
